reason: I already pay SiteMinder for the booking engine and channel manager, so a studio selling me a booking page and a WhatsApp bot sounds like a second system I would have to run. The 15-25% Booking.com cut is my real pain, but nothing here shows me how it saves money on my own bookings.
objection: Does this plug into the SiteMinder I already pay for, or is it another login and another thing to check every morning during the season?
would_change_my_mind: A clear answer that it connects to my existing channel manager, plus a real guesthouse of my size showing its share of direct bookings went up with the same setup.
